recentItems.title: Portrait of an Artist: Stephen Curry - Official Trailer (2026) Documentary
recentItems.description:
Take a look at the Official Trailer for Portrait of an Artist: Stephen Curry, a sports documentary centered around NBA legend Stephen Curry, distributed by Disney. Fans can witness the career of the iconic player with Portrait of an Artist: Stephen Curry, in theaters exclusively in IMAX on October 9.

On the verge of his record-extending 4,000th career three-pointer, four-time NBA champion and two-time MVP Stephen Curry reflects on the upbringing, mindset and work ethic that have made him among the most legendary artists of our time. The film captures Curry leading up to and throughout one remarkable game, weaving together his generational artistry with perspectives from other innovative artists – including Viola Davis, Rick Rubin, Patti Smith and Jon Batiste – showcasing how his singular vision has permanently transformed the game of basketball.

This state-of-the-art production utilized 21 IMAX-certified cameras to capture the urgency and emotion around this historic single day and single game. 

When Curry hit his 4,000th career three-pointer, it wasn’t just another record – it was something the league had literally never seen before. Curry entered the home game at Chase Center against the Sacramento Kings needing just two threes to reach the unprecedented milestone of 4,000 career three-pointers. Curry became the first player in NBA history to reach this historic milestone. The Warriors went on to win the game 130-104.

“Portrait of an Artist: Stephen Curry” is directed by Gotham Chopra; produced by John Turner, Meghan Cirillo, Nick Frew, Erick Peyton and Sharla Sumpter Bridgett. 

Portrait of an Artist: Stephen Curry releases exclusively in IMAX theaters on October 9.

recentItems.title: Dune: Awakening - Official Console and Single-Player Launch Trailer
recentItems.description: Check out the latest Dune: Awakening trailer for this open-world survival game, and take a look at the update, which features single-player mode, gameplay customizations, and the conclusion of the Book One story. Dune: Awakening is out now on Steam, PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X/S, Xbox Game Pass, Xbox on PC, and Xbox Cloud. The console launch is out today, September 17, for Deluxe and Ultimate edition owners, with a full release coming to consoles on September 22, 2026. The update is out now.

recentItems.title: GTA 6 is Getting a Physical Release (But Not The Game) - IGN Daily Fix
recentItems.description:
In today's Daily Fix:

Rockstar Games has announced a physical release for the Grand Theft Auto 6 soundtrack. While probably not the physical disc announcement fans were hoping for, there is enough here for the die-hard collector. The GTA 6 album will be released in a double-CD set for $20, a double-vinyl set for $50, and a limited edition double-vinyl set for $125. A few of the tracks are already up on Spotify. In other news, Hideo Kojima has announced major casting news for Physint: Bill Skarsgård will play the as-yet unnamed lead role. The game was recently saved from cancellation by Xbox, who picked up publishing rights from Sony. And finally, Lollipop Chainsaw 2: Back2Back has been announced.

recentItems.title: How To Rob A Bank - Official Trailer 2 (2026) Nicholas Hoult, Zoë Kravitz, John C. Reilly
recentItems.description:
Don't miss the Official Trailer 2 for How to Rob A Bank, an upcoming movie starring Nicholas Hoult, Zoë Kravitz, Anna Sawai, Rhenzy Feliz, Christian Slater, with Pete Davidson and John C. Reilly. Witness viral fame get the best of a group of bank robbers in How to Rob A Bank, in theaters on September 4.

In How To Rob A Bank, a crew of social media-savvy bank robbers broadcasts their daring heists, unaware that their growing viral fame has put them in the crosshairs of a veteran FBI agent and a brilliant software engineer. Despite the unlikely duo closing in, the crime ring pushes past their limits, putting everything on the line for their beliefs — and their most ambitious heist yet.

How To Rob A Bank, directed by David Leitch, opens in theaters on September 4, 2026.
